houseAblation.rule: set bao namua houseValue evaluator weight to zero; all other weights unchanged

reserveAblation.rule: set bao namua reserveEfficiency evaluator weight to zero; all other weights unchanged

ablationDiagnostics.search: D2_Q1 exact complete-root under same search semantics

eventEntry.referenceConsensus: D3_Q1_REFERENCE and B1024_Q1_MAXD3 both complete depth 3 and exact TopSet plus canonicalBest are identical
eventEntry.referenceDisagreementEvent: reference consensus true and D2_Q1_BASE canonicalBest is outside reference TopSet

f10Continuation.continuationPolicy: at every nonterminal continuation state choose canonical D2_Q1 best for side to move
f10Continuation.terminalBeforeHorizon: F10_NON_ESTIMABLE_FOR_EVENT; terminal outcome not used for assignment

MDFT-F01.assign: D1_Q1 canonicalBest equals D2_Q1_BASE canonicalBest and that move is outside reference TopSet

MDFT-F02.assign: D2_Q0 canonicalBest outside reference TopSet AND D2_Q2 canonicalBest inside reference TopSet

MDFT-F03.assign: B256 estimable AND completedDepth < 3 AND B256 canonicalBest outside reference TopSet while B1024 completedDepth = 3 and agrees with reference

MDFT-F04.applicable: reference disagreement event with at least 3 nonterminal replies after baselineCanonicalBest
MDFT-F04.assign: the reply ranked most adverse by resolvedReplyScore has staticReplyScore adverse-rank strictly worse than ceil(N/2)

MDFT-F05.assign: baseline and reference search-consistent canonical line tactical signatures differ and at least one signature contains a capture move or forced-capture state within first 3 nominal plies

MDFT-F06.applicable: reference disagreement event with at least 4 legal root moves
MDFT-F06.assign: D2-vs-D3 tie-aware Spearman rho <= 0.50 OR maximum normalized absolute rank displacement >= 0.50

MDFT-F07.assign: reserve-ablation D2_Q1 canonicalBest is inside reference TopSet

MDFT-F08.assign: house-ablation D2_Q1 canonicalBest is inside reference TopSet

MDFT-F10.applicable: reference disagreement event with both 6-ply branches nonterminal through horizon
MDFT-F10.assign: at least 2 structural coordinates meet their frozen material-difference thresholds

promotion.leafNonEstimable: applicable-event minimum not met; leaf not promoted and not counted as negative validation

replyDiagnostic.ranking: ascending score then exact reply key because lower is more adverse to root actor
replyDiagnostic.replySet: all exact legal opponent replies after selected root move
replyDiagnostic.resolvedReplyScore: exact D1_Q1 score from post-reply state from root actor perspective when nonterminal
replyDiagnostic.staticReplyScore: AI bao evaluation of post-reply state from root actor perspective; terminal reply rows retained only for replay flags and excluded from F04 rank assignment

rootSelection.duplicateSelectedRawStateHandling: retain minimum trajectoryHash then seed then ply

withinTrajectoryOccurrence.trajectoryHashExcludedBecause: trajectoryHash is not available until the trajectory has completed; it is intentionally not part of the within-trajectory occurrence rank

searchGrid.canonicalBest: lexical minimum exact move key in TopSet
searchGrid.semantics: SRDR controlled complete-root search validated by MDFT Stage 0

postOpeningPolicyByGameIndexModulo4.rule: seeded uniform over all exact legal moves
seeded uniform over exact capture moves when any exist, else all legal
seeded uniform over moves maximizing immediate captured-seed count
seeded uniform over moves minimizing immediate captured-seed count

specHashRule: SHA256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators after removing specSha256

stage2TargetFreezeProcedure.ifStage1Pass: freeze exactly the promoted leaf IDs with the existing assignment rules; do not add leaves; create separate Stage 2 spec, source freeze and authorization before consuming Stage 2 seeds

trajectoryIdentity.duplicateTrajectoryHandling: retain minimum seed then game index
trajectoryIdentity.openingPrefixHash: SHA256 of explicit opening length and first 8 exact move keys
trajectoryIdentity.trajectoryHash: SHA256 of ordered authoritative RAW identity keys from initial through final observed state
